description: The first human travellers to alien worlds needed a lot of augmentation to survive.
This alloy-encased core survived the Liberator's impact with planet Neri's surface.
Ancient holo-map that spans far beyond the Federation frontier.
Encrypted codex in a language as-yet undeciphered by Federation data analysts.
Burn this NFT to raise a specific Land's Rating to the average Rating between all lands.
Burn this NFT to raise a specific Land's Rating halfway between your own Rating and the top Rating.
